correctness.rationale: The exact Apéry formula is proved for each residue class and yields finite gap sets and genus. For even n, a primitive prime divisor of the genus gives a nonzero gap-polynomial evaluation. For odd n, equation (2) is derived with all denominators handled; the quadratic nonvanishing follows from a unit-circle realness argument, and the only singular cube-root case has an explicit nonzero sum. Necessity/sufficiency for all m follows by the full set of m-th roots. A separate shortest-path enumeration verified 29,098 (n,m) pairs, but finite tests do not replace the infinite proof. Risks: symbolic sign or exponent slips were checked with both algebraic recomputation and small examples; no unproved external lemma beyond elementary finite Fourier criterion is needed.

value.rationale: Complete infinite two-parameter classification of natural residue equidistribution of Frobenius gaps for the simplest genuinely three-generated consecutive family (n>=4). The divisor dichotomy and unique prime-three obstruction are structural information not captured by genus or a generic Fourier test. Uniform gap residues are a motivated subject in Shor (2021/2022), and the exact result can benchmark larger arithmetic-progression families. The result is specific and self-contained; no unproved downstream application is claimed.
